title: Execute reached COBOL data, decimal, string, condition, and function semantics
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of core_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: One program storage base plus qualified alias views preserves group, child, REDEFINES, rename, subscript, and reference-modification overlap instead of copying independent layout storage.
Typed layout metadata carries picture, digits, scale, sign, separate sign, element length, occurrence, parent, and condition values into the executable IR.

DISPLAY, packed decimal, binary, numeric-edited, signed overpunch, scale alignment, expression precedence, truncation, ROUNDED, divide-by-zero, and target overflow use bounded checked decimal operations.

MOVE and group MOVE, STRING, UNSTRING, INSPECT replacing/tallying, INITIALIZE, condition-name SET/IF, SPACES/ZEROS/LOW-VALUES/HIGH-VALUES, and shared group mutation pass exact output or typed negative controls.
Subscripts and reference modification use 1-based checked extents; zero, overflow, malformed, and out-of-range inputs fail as typed machine problems without partial writes.

CURRENT-DATE is deterministic and accepts only an explicit invocation binding override; DATE-OF-INTEGER, INTEGER-OF-DATE, LENGTH, case conversion, TRIM, NUMVAL/NUMVAL-C, TEST-NUMVAL variants, and MOD cover every function reached by executable CardDemo source.

The CD-005 graph now lowers to explicit control operations; multiline IF, EVALUATE, branch convergence, VARYING initialization/increment/UNTIL, loop reentry, and checkpoint state execute without the temporary StructuredControl publication block.
Checkpoint schema 2 persists structured-loop reentry and counters while schema 1 remains readable; a mid-loop restore has byte-exact terminal equivalence.
The corpus receipt derives exact layout and operand counts plus a length-delimited shape digest across all 44 closures, while two executable core oracles have an exact combined output digest.
